appDesc.message: A two-factor authenticator for Chrome: TOTP codes from an encrypted vault in your browser profile, with backups you control.

emptyList.message: Paste a setup link, key or QR screenshot with $1, or scan the QR code on this page.

copiedNext.message: Under 3s left, copied the next code

hotpTitle.message: Counter-based (HOTP) accounts are kept safe but cannot generate codes yet

noPasswordNotice.message: Codes are only lightly protected on this computer. Set a master password.

recoveredBody.message: The stored copy was damaged. Restored to the state saved at $1.

welcomeBody.message: Your accounts are kept on this computer and never leave it unless you export them.

lostTitle.message: Stored data could not be read

lostBody.message: Sixkey could not read your saved accounts, and no usable copy was found. Restore from a backup file.

newerBody.message: This data was saved by a newer version of Sixkey. Update the extension to open it. Nothing has been changed.

errorBody.message: Something unexpected went wrong. Try again. If it keeps failing, save diagnostics under Settings › Advanced.

wrongRecovery.message: That recovery key does not match

badRecoveryFormat.message: That does not look like a recovery key

lockHint.message: If you forget the master password and lose the recovery key, your data cannot be recovered. We cannot help either.

optScan.message: Scan QR code on this page

optScanD.message: Reads the visible part of the current tab

scanNone.message: No QR code on the visible part of this page. Scroll it into view, or paste it.

optionsLead.message: Settings, backups and importing. Everything stays on this computer.

emptyOptions.message: No vault yet. First a master password, then a recovery key; nothing is saved until both are done.

deviceOnlyBody.message: Your accounts are protected only by a key stored next to them. That stops casual reading but not someone, or malware, with access to this browser profile. With a master password, a copy of the profile is as safe as the password you choose.

passwordLossWarning.message: If you forget the master password and lose the recovery key, your data cannot be recovered. We cannot help either.

strengthHint.message: At least $1 bits estimated strength. Longer is better; a random phrase works.

strengthLow.message: Estimated $1 of $2 bits: $3 bits short. Make it longer or less predictable.

newCodeBody.message: Replaces the current key, which stops working.

rotateBody.message: Use this if you think an old copy of your data or key may have leaked. Everything is re-encrypted with a new key and you get a new recovery key.

recoveryShownBody.message: If you forget the master password, this key is the only way back in. It is shown once. Keep it where it stays safe even if this computer is lost, such as a printout or a password manager on another device.

recoverySavedCheck.message: I have saved my recovery key

lockOnScreenLock.message: Also lock when the computer's screen locks

autoLockNote.message: Applies when a master password is set. Updating or reloading the extension always locks it.

pasteHelp.message: Paste otpauth:// links, Google Authenticator export links, or plain keys (a key alone, or name|key), one per line, or choose files below. Nothing is added until you confirm.

dropOrPasteImage.message: or drop files here: text, JSON or CSV exports (Aegis, 2FAS, andOTP, Raivo, Bitwarden) and QR images. Paste a screenshot with Ctrl+V.

previewDup.message: $1 already in your list or repeated, skipped

previewIncomplete.message: Google export: $1 of $2 codes read. Still needed: $3.

previewHotp.message: $1 counter-based account(s) will be kept but cannot generate codes yet.

previewShort.message: $1 account(s) use a short key. They will work, but the service issued a weak key.

incompleteHint.message: Add the remaining codes first, or add what you have.

rNotOtpauth.message: not a link or a key

googleStep1.message: In Google Authenticator, choose Transfer accounts, then Export accounts. It shows one or more QR codes.

googleStep2.message: Scan each code with the camera here, or take screenshots and choose or drop them above.

googleStep3.message: Delete the screenshots and exported files afterwards: they contain your keys.

backupLead.message: Keep a copy outside the browser. An encrypted backup file is safe to store in cloud drive or email.

exportEncryptedBody.message: Protected by a password you choose here. It is separate from your master password, and without it the file cannot be opened.

backupSaved.message: Encrypted backup created. Check that your browser actually saved the file.

exportPlainBody.message: A list of otpauth:// links that anyone can read, including all your secret keys. Use it only to move to another app, and delete it afterwards.

exportPlainCheck.message: I understand this file is not encrypted

plainSaved.message: Plain text list created. Check that it was saved, and delete it when you are done.

restoreBody.message: Choose a Sixkey backup file. Your accounts come back exactly as they were.

importBody.message: Choose a Sixkey backup file. A backup of this same vault is merged; one from another vault adds its accounts here. Exports from other apps open in Add account.

backupWrongOrDamaged.message: Wrong password, or the file is damaged

backupInvalid.message: This is not a Sixkey backup file

newerFormat.message: This backup was made by a newer version of Sixkey

loadedIntoAdd.message: This is not a Sixkey backup. Open it in

trashLead.message: Deleted accounts stay here until you erase them for good. Nothing is erased automatically.

purgedNote.message: Some accounts were erased for good. Only a marker remains so the deletion stays deleted.

clipBody.message: After you copy a code, clear it from the clipboard 30 seconds later, but only if the clipboard still holds that code. This asks the browser for permission to read and change the clipboard.

clipHistoryNote.message: Clipboard history tools (such as Windows Win+V) may keep their own copy, which Sixkey cannot remove.

clockBody.message: Codes depend on the time. If your clock is off by more than about 15 seconds, codes fail. Turn on automatic time in your system settings. Sixkey makes no network requests, so it cannot check this itself.

diagBody.message: A local log of recoveries and non-fatal problems. It has no keys, codes or account names. Nothing is sent anywhere; save it and send it to us only if you want help.

startOverTitle.message: Start over with an empty vault

startOverBody.message: Only if you have no backup. This permanently discards whatever unreadable data remains.

invalidData.message: That data is too long or not valid, so it was not saved

alreadyProtected.message: A master password is already set

trashClearOld.message: Erase $1 item(s) older than $2 days for good

residueWarning.message: Accounts you added before turning this on may still be recoverable from leftover data on disk until the browser compacts its storage. If this browser profile was ever copied or shared, re-issue those accounts' 2FA keys at each service.

secLead.message: How your accounts are protected on this computer, and what happens when you lock.

addLead.message: Bring accounts in from links, files, QR images, the camera, or by typing a key. Nothing is added until you confirm.

addPrivacy.message: Keys are read on this computer and never uploaded. QR images are not kept.

frRestoreLead.message: Choose the backup, then set a master password for this computer: the accounts are saved under it from the start.

frStartOverLead.message: A new, empty vault with a master password. Nothing is erased until you finish.

frCodeNote.message: Nothing is saved until you finish. If you close this page before that, this key will not open anything; you will get a new one.

frRiskTitle.message: Is this browser profile used only by you?

frRiskBody.message: Could it be used by others, synced to an anti-detect browser vendor's cloud, or controlled by scripts or automation tools?

frSoloBody.message: Locks after 15 idle minutes or when the screen locks.

frSharedBody.message: Locks every time you close Sixkey, and codes are hidden by default. Do not turn on sync in such a profile.

frRiskNote.message: You can change this later in Settings › Security › Security mode.

frClipLead.message: Recommended for a shared or automated profile.

frChanged.message: Sixkey was set up or changed in another page meanwhile. Nothing was changed here.

frCreateInstead.message: Start with an empty vault instead

frScanHint.message: You can also click the Sixkey icon on a website to read a QR code shown on the page.

resetLead.message: Set a new master password with your recovery key. The recovery key stays the same and keeps working.

resetChanged.message: Your password or recovery key was changed in another window meanwhile, so nothing was changed here and the key that was shown will not work. Start again.

resetDone.message: Your master password was reset. Use the new password and the new recovery key from now on.

resetDoneLocked.message: Your master password was reset. Unlock with the new password.

siteBound.message: This account is already remembered for $1. Remember only if this page is the same service.

afsOthersTitle.message: Turned on on your other computers

afsOthersLead.message: Chrome asks on each computer before Sixkey may look at a site, so turn these on here once.

cmdFill.message: Fill the verification code on this page

fillTitleNoBox.message: Sixkey: no code box found on this page

fillTitleNoSite.message: Sixkey: no account is registered for this site

fillTitleChoose.message: Sixkey: open it to choose what to fill

fillTitleLocked.message: Sixkey is locked: open it to unlock

fillTitleBlocked.message: Sixkey cannot fill on this page

fillTitleInsecure.message: Sixkey: this page is not secure (http): open Sixkey to fill

fillTitleFailed.message: Sixkey: the page did not accept the code

fillTitleUnsure.message: Sixkey: the code may have been entered: check the page

fillTitleSlow.message: Sixkey: the page did not answer in time: try again

fillTitleOld.message: Sixkey: autofill needs Chrome 140 or later

lockFillFor.message: Unlock to fill the code on $1

afCanFill.message: Sixkey can fill the code here: press $1

afCanFillOpen.message: Sixkey can fill the code here: open Sixkey

afsLead.message: Sites where you turned on code suggestions. On each, Chrome lets Sixkey read and change the site's pages; Sixkey looks only for the verification-code box and sends nothing anywhere. Secure (https) pages only.

afsNone.message: No sites yet. After a fill on an https site, Sixkey offers to turn it on there.

afsChrome.message: Chrome keeps this list of sites in its own settings, unencrypted. Remove also gives back Chrome's access to that site; Chrome remembers that you allowed it once, so turning it on again does not ask again.

afsOld.message: Code suggestions need Chrome 140 or later.

pinLength.message: Your PIN has $1 digits. Type it again.

afSugGo.message: Press Enter to fill the code on $1

autoGroupTip.message: Group by name: the accounts of each service in a group of their own. Accounts already in a group stay.

listRevealHint.message: Click copies the code without showing it. Hold, or press Space, to show it for 5 seconds.

siteRememberHelp.message: This account will show as “This site” on the address you choose and on every address under it. Choose a shorter one only if all of it belongs to this service, and do this only on the real site.

siteNone.message: $1 is shared by many unrelated sites, so it cannot be remembered.

siteHelp.message: Shown as “This site” only on these addresses and the addresses under them.

siteInvalid.message: Enter a site address, such as example.com.

siteShared.message: $1 is shared by many unrelated sites. Enter the full address, such as name.$1.

siteTooMany.message: An account can have at most $1 sites.

paZone.message: Paste a link, key or QR screenshot

paZoneHelp.message: An otpauth:// or Google export link, a key on its own, or a screenshot of the QR code. Nothing is added until you confirm.

paNoQr.message: No QR code found in the image. Try a larger, sharper screenshot.

paExists.message: Already in Sixkey as $1. Nothing to add.

paSameKey.message: This key is already saved as $1. It may be the same QR code scanned twice.

paRebind.message: You already have $1 with a different key. Replace the old one, or keep both?

paReplace.message: Replace: the old one goes to the trash

paFromText.message: Read as a plain key: 6 digits every 30 seconds, the usual setting. Check that it is a real 2FA key.

paNext.message: Next: enter this code on the website to finish. If the site says it is wrong, first check that your computer sets its clock automatically.

paColumns.message: These lines have several columns, such as name|key|password. In Settings you choose the key column, and the others are never saved. Paste them there.

paMore.message: Paste the next screenshot here, or continue in Settings.

linesHelp.message: $1 line(s) have columns split by |. Only the key column and the name column are read. Every other column, such as a password, is dropped and never saved.

linesColumn.message: Column $1 · $2 characters · a key in $3 of $4 lines

linesPending.message: Choose the key column: $1 line(s) are not added until you do.

linesFromText.message: $1 from plain text, set to 6 digits every 30 seconds, the usual setting. Check that each is a real 2FA key.

linesUnnamed.message: $1 without a name. You can name them in the popup after adding.

rNotKey.message: too short for a key (16 characters or more)

instTitle.message: Not from the Chrome Web Store

instBody.message: This copy does not update itself.

instLong.message: This copy does not update itself, so check for new versions by hand. Install Sixkey only from its Chrome Web Store listing, or from a file you made yourself from that listing. Never install a file someone sends you.

instStoreId.message: Sixkey's ID in the Chrome Web Store

instNoStoreYet.message: Sixkey is not in the Chrome Web Store yet, so there is no official ID to compare with yet.

instLimit.message: This check finds old copies that never update. It cannot catch a modified copy: such a copy can simply remove the check.

lookLead.message: How Sixkey looks in this browser, and how the popup and the side panel list your accounts.

lookThemeNote.message: Saved in this browser only, like the language. It is not part of a backup.

lookDensityNote.message: Compact puts each account on one line, so about 12 fit in the popup. The current website's accounts keep the full size.

lookSortNote.message: Manual is the order you drag accounts into. Either way, the current website's accounts come first.

lookHide.message: Hide codes in the popup and the side panel

lookShortcutBody.message: Opens Sixkey on any page, as a click on its icon does:

lookShortcutWhere.message: Or type $1 in the address bar.

smLead.message: Two ready-made sets of the settings below, the same as the question when Sixkey was set up. Change any one of them and the mode shows as Custom.

smCustomBody.message: Your own choice of the settings below. Pick a mode above to go back to it.

smClipNote.message: In a shared or automated profile, also clear the clipboard after each copy:

smLockedNow.message: Sixkey is locked now. Unlock it at the top of this page to go on.

expPwLead.message: Every export asks you to confirm again, even while Sixkey is unlocked: with your PIN, or your master password when there is no PIN.

expNoPw.message: This vault has no master password for an export to ask for: anyone at this browser can save your secret keys. Turn one on under Security.

expSubBody.message: For a shared or vendor-cloud profile: whoever uses it gets only these accounts. The file has its own password; open it there with Restore or Import.

expSubOnly.message: The file holds only these $1 account(s):

expSubSamePw.message: Use a password other than your master password: whoever opens the file will know it.

expSubSaved.message: File with $1 account(s) created. Check that your browser saved it.

expSubChanged.message: The selected accounts changed in another page. Nothing was saved: check the list and save again.

secNoticeFailed.message: $1 wrong password, recovery key or PIN attempt(s) since you last saw this.

secNoticeBad.message: The security record can't be read.

secLogCount.message: Wrong attempts not yet shown after an unlock: $1

secLogDamaged.message: It is damaged. The next entry starts a new one.

secLogNewer.message: A newer version of Sixkey wrote it. This version does not add to it.

secLogClearLead.message: Needs your PIN, or your master password when there is no PIN. A wrong one is refused and recorded. One dated line stays.

secKPasswordReset.message: Master password reset with the recovery key

secInvTitle.message: What Sixkey keeps in this browser profile

secInvKeysPw.message: Your accounts, encrypted, and the key that opens them, locked by your master password and by your recovery key.

secInvKeysDevice.message: Your accounts, encrypted, and the key that opens them, kept beside them unlocked: a copy of this profile opens them.

secInvSnaps.message: $1 older encrypted copies (the last 10 saves, one a day for 7 days).

secInvMirror.message: A second encrypted copy, and up to 7 daily ones, in this profile's IndexedDB.

secInvNoMirror.message: No copy found in this profile's IndexedDB.

secInvSettings.message: Settings: locking, display, language, theme, any install warning, an ID that orders edits, upkeep markers (no keys), and the last backup ($1).

secInvLogs.message: This record, notes of automatic restores, and a log of minor problems. None holds keys, codes or account names.

secInvSession.message: While unlocked: the opened key, in the browser's memory-only session storage (not when locking every time).

errRead.message: Sixkey could not read its data on this computer

errSave.message: This change could not be saved, and your accounts are as they were

errSpace.message: There is not enough free disk space to save

errNextRetry.message: Try again. If it keeps failing, save diagnostics under $1.

errNextRestore.message: Try again. If it keeps failing, restore from a backup file under $1.

errNextSpace.message: Free up some disk space on this computer, then try again.

errNextWeak.message: Make it longer: a few random words work well, or use “$1”.

errNextReload.message: Reload this page and try again.

errNextUnlock.message: Unlock it with your master password, then try again.

errNextBackupPw.message: Enter the password this backup was saved with. It can differ from your master password.

errNextUpdate.message: Update Sixkey, then try again. Nothing has been changed.

fakeSiteTitle.message: This may be a fake site

fakeCopyAgain.message: This page looks like a fake of this account's site. Click again to copy anyway.

httpSite.message: $1 uses http: a code typed here can be read on the way.

frPinBody.message: Unlock with a PIN of 4 to 8 digits every day, also after the browser restarts, instead of typing the master password. After 5 wrong PINs in a row, the master password is needed once. No need to type the master password again now.

frPinLater.message: The PIN was not set here. You can set it any time in Settings › Security › PIN quick unlock.

frSavedLead.message: Your vault is saved. One more step, then your first account.

welcomeStartAlone.message: Don't restore: make a separate vault

groupsLead.message: Tick accounts, then move them into a group. Each group is a section of the popup's list; a new group comes last.

groupsSearch.message: Search by name, account or group

groupsCleared.message: Took $1 account(s) out of their groups.

addNothing.message: Paste links, choose a file or scan a QR code first.

camHint.message: Hold the QR code up to the camera.

camDenied.message: Sixkey is not allowed to use the camera. Allow it with the camera icon in the address bar or in this extension's site settings (on a Mac, also in System Settings › Privacy & Security › Camera).

camFailed.message: The camera could not be started: there is none, or another app is using it.

camOther.message: This code is from another Google Authenticator export. Finish this one first, or add what you have.

fileNotText.message: Not a text, JSON, CSV or image file.

fileIsBackup.message: A Sixkey backup: import it under Backup.

fileHtml.message: A web page export: its codes are only pictures. Scan them with the camera, or choose screenshots of them.

delAsk.message: $1 holds your secret keys in plain text. Delete it now?

delPlain.message: $1 holds your secret keys in plain text.

delNote.message: Deleting does not guarantee it cannot be recovered.

delLeft.message: Accounts in it not imported: $1. Deleting the file loses them.

delHotp.message: Counter-based (HOTP) accounts from it: $1. Sixkey keeps them but cannot make their codes yet.

delChanged.message: $1 changed after Sixkey read it, so it was not deleted.

delManual.message: Delete it yourself: move it to the Trash or Recycle Bin, then empty it.

delAuto.message: Adding also deletes $1, which holds your keys in plain text. Chrome asks you to allow it first.

errCleanupPending.message: An earlier key change is still being finished on this computer

errNextCleanupPending.message: Lock Sixkey and unlock it again, then try again. Nothing was changed.

secKPrfEnrolled.message: Unlock with Touch ID or Windows Hello added

secKPrfRemoved.message: Unlock with Touch ID or Windows Hello removed

secKPrfFailed.message: Unlocking with Touch ID or Windows Hello failed

macLinkBody.message: Let the Sixkey app on this Mac keep the same vault. Sixkey sends it encrypted after each change; the app opens it with your master password.

macLinkNoVault.message: Linked with Sixkey for Mac $1. It has no vault yet.

macLinkNoApp.message: Sixkey for Mac does not answer on this computer.

macLinkNeedsPassword.message: Set a master password first: the app opens the vault only with it.

strengthHintOwn.message: At least $1 characters. $2 bits or more is best: a few random words work well.

strengthLowOwn.message: Estimated $1 bits, below the $2 we recommend.

strengthCommon.message: Too easy to guess: too close to a common password.

pwWeakWhy.message: Someone who copies this browser profile can guess offline, with no limit on tries: one graphics card finds a password this strong in about $1, and more cards are faster.

pwWeakWhyFile.message: Someone who gets this file can guess offline, with no limit on tries: one graphics card finds a password this strong in about $1, and more cards are faster.

lockPinWaiting.message: The PIN works again once you type the master password.

pwWordsHint.message: Type the 5 words; spaces or hyphens both work.

strengthFloor.message: Too predictable: avoid keyboard runs, sequences and repeats.

pwWhyChars.message: $1 random characters: about $2 bits, well above the $3-bit bar.

pwWhyWords.message: $1 random words: about $2 bits, above the $3-bit bar.

pwSaveMaster.message: Save it in your password manager or write it on paper.

pwSaveFile.message: Save it in your password manager or write it on paper: the file cannot be opened without it.

pinTriesLeft.message: Tries left: $1. After that, the master password.

pinClose.message: To lock whenever the popup closes, choose “$1” under Automatic lock. The PIN opens it again.

pinWaiting.message: On ($1 digits). It works again after you next type the master password.

pinShared.message: Not available: this profile is declared shared or controlled by scripts (Security mode), and they could read a PIN.

pinWeak.message: Too easy to guess. Avoid repeated digits, runs like 1234 and common PINs.

quickEnded.message: Ended. Sixkey is locked, and the master password opens it.

eraseNeedsPassword.message: Deleting for good cannot be undone, so it asks for your PIN, or your master password when there is no PIN.

paChoose.message: For each account of a name you already have: replace the old one, or keep both.

fieldNoteHint.message: To tell it from an account of the same name, e.g. Shop A

fileLockedMeanwhile.message: Sixkey locked while the file was being read. Choose it again.

panelTabHint.message: Click the Sixkey icon on this tab to match its site and scan it.

fillTitleAsk.message: Sixkey: open it and click Fill code
